data.title: 伊卡洛斯 · 池畔长椅的晒翼小憩
data.description: 游完几圈后的午后，泳池边的木长椅被太阳晒得微暖。伊卡洛斯把白毛巾工工整整叠在膝头，赤脚并拢端坐在树荫边缘，微微张开带着水珠的双翼让暖风吹干，怀边还乖巧地放着一瓶冰凉的麦茶。
data.location: 树影婆娑的校园泳池边木长椅
data.action: 端坐木长椅膝放白毛巾，轻展微湿双翼吹风休息
data.lighting: 树叶间筛落的斑驳晴光与池水柔和反光
data.camera: 四分之三全身，兼顾泳池背景与舒展羽翼
data.mood: 宁静、乖巧、夏日微风的安适
data.promptProse: Seated neatly on a wooden bench along the shaded edge of the school pool, Ikaros rests a neatly folded white towel on her lap beside a chilled bottle of barley tea. She spreads her damp wings slightly to dry in the warm afternoon breeze while dappled sunlight flickers across the tiles.
data.animaCaption: Seated neatly on the shaded poolside bench with a folded towel on her lap, she airs her wings in the breeze.
